Dear Mr. Abbott,

Re: Account reference: ACC-287143

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account with our agency, Pinnacle Asset Management. You have disputed the amount of $4,064.29 as incorrect. We understand that you have concerns regarding the reporting of this account to the credit bureaus.

We take all disputes seriously and will investigate the matter. Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we should have provided you with written validation of the debt prior to reporting it to the credit bureaus. However, our records indicate that we did not request validation from you.

We will investigate the accuracy of the amount and verify the debt with the original creditor, Citylink Communications. We will also review our reporting practices to ensure compliance with the FDCPA and Maryland state law.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this account further if you believe that the amount or the debt is not valid. We will provide you with an update on our investigation and any necessary actions within a reasonable time.

Sincerely,

Pinnacle Asset Management
